method: Each population id is ranked by the hex sha256 of the seed, a newline and the id, ascending, and the first n are drawn. K is the smallest count of bad blocks that puts the population's good rate under 90 %; n is the smallest sample whose probability of drawing no bad block among N with K bad is at most 0.05 (hypergeometric, no failure allowed). Only vitest blocks are drawn.
